What we do

Wood and vinyl, done properly

From a single-room refinish to a full pre-war restoration — measured in person, quoted in writing, and finished on schedule.

01

Hardwood installation

Solid and engineered hardwood in straight plank, herringbone, and chevron — including wide-plank white oak, a go-to for light, calm rooms.

02

Refinishing & restoration

Sanding, stain, and finish that bring worn floors back — often for a fraction of replacement, and the smart first move in pre-war apartments.

03

Custom staining

From natural matte to deep espresso walnut tones. You approve a sample on your own floor before we commit to a color — no surprises.

04

Luxury vinyl plank

Waterproof, quiet, and convincingly wood-like. A practical luxury for kitchens, rentals, and high-traffic family homes.

05

Stairs & detail work

Treads, risers, borders, and inlays matched to your existing floor — the finishing details that make a renovation look original.

06

Repairs & board-ups

Water damage, pet stains, squeaks, and single-board replacement, blended to match the surrounding floor as closely as the wood allows.

Co-op & condo friendly

We speak fluent building board

In Manhattan, the floor is the easy part. The approval is the job. We handle the paperwork so your project doesn't stall in a managing agent's inbox.

  • Board packages, handled: alteration agreements, certificates of insurance, and contractor documents prepared for your building.
  • Building rules respected: freight-elevator bookings, work-hour windows, and hallway protection built into the schedule.
  • Sound & underlayment guidance: the right underlayment for your building's acoustic requirements, chosen before install day.
  • One point of contact: you, your board, and your building staff hear from the same person — no telephone game.
